About us

Care for every family, not just one kind of household

Any Help Any Time exists so families don't have to choose between working, caring, and knowing their elder is safe. We pick elders up from home, look after what they need for the day, and bring them safely back — with real people you can get to know and rate.

Our promise

Every visit is done by a companion whose ratings you can see before you book, and whose work you can rate afterward.

Built for every age

Large text, simple navigation, and clear steps — this site is designed to be used by elders themselves, not just their families.

More than a visit

Festivals, outings and community events mean care doesn't stop at errands and health checks.

Trust & safety

How we keep every visit safe

Letting someone into your family's life takes trust. Here's exactly what we do before, during and after every visit to earn it.

ID & background checks

Every companion completes identity verification and a police background check before their first visit — no exceptions.

Trained & refreshed

Companions are trained in first aid, elder care essentials and our code of conduct, with regular refresher check-ins.

Named & rated, every time

You always know who's coming before they arrive. Every visit is logged, and any low rating is reviewed by our team personally.

Real support, any time

A real person is a phone call away if anything comes up before, during or after a visit — not a bot.

Have a safety question or concern? Contact our team any time, or read our full Terms & Conditions.

Legal

Terms & Conditions and Privacy Policy

Draft template only — not legal advice. Have a qualified lawyer review and finalize these before publishing, especially for Australian privacy-law obligations.

Terms & Conditions

By registering for or using Any Help Any Time's services, you agree to these terms. Services are booked through registered accounts and paid for according to the pricing shown on this site at the time of booking.

Cancellations and rescheduling should be made with reasonable notice; our team will confirm the notice period that applies to your package. Companions are engaged and screened by Any Help Any Time; ratings left by families and elders help us maintain quality but do not form part of any legal warranty.

We reserve the right to decline or pause a service where a request falls outside what our companions are trained or authorized to provide, including medical procedures beyond routine health checks.

Privacy Policy

We collect the information you provide when registering (name, contact details, and any care notes you choose to share) to arrange and deliver services. Companion applicants' information is used to review and manage applications.

We do not sell personal information. Information is shared only with the companions assigned to a visit and with staff who need it to run the service. You can ask us to correct or delete your information at any time by contacting us.

Health-related notes (such as mobility needs or health-check results) are treated as sensitive information and are only shared with the companions directly involved in a visit.
